mapper.select:
select c.id, c.document_id, c.chunk_no, c.section_path, c.page_no, c.content, c.normalized, c.keywords, d.title, d.protocol_code, d.protocol_version, d.source_document_id from ai_chunk c join ai_document d on d.id = c.document_id where d.status = 'PUBLISHED' and d.source_document_id = #{sourceDocumentId} and c.normalized like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
limit #{limit}
select id, source, source_document_id, protocol_code, protocol_version, title, content_hash, status, chunk_count, index_version, updated_at from ai_document order by updated_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_document (id, source, source_document_id, protocol_code, protocol_version, title, content_hash, status, chunk_count, index_version, failure_reason) values (#{id}, #{source}, #{sourceDocumentId}, #{protocolCode}, #{protocolVersion}, #{title}, #{contentHash}, #{status}, #{chunkCount}, #{indexVersion}, #{failureReason}) on conflict (source, source_document_id) do update set protocol_code = excluded.protocol_code, protocol_version = excluded.protocol_version, title = excluded.title, content_hash = excluded.content_hash, status = excluded.status, chunk_count = excluded.chunk_count, index_version = excluded.index_version, failure_reason = excluded.failure_reason, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: select chunk_no as "chunkNo", section_path as "sectionPath", page_no as "pageNo", content from ai_chunk where document_id = #{documentId} order by chunk_no limit 50
mapper.insert: insert into ai_chunk (id, document_id, chunk_no, section_path, page_no, content, normalized, keywords, token_count, index_version) values (#{id}, #{documentId}, #{chunkNo}, #{sectionPath}, #{pageNo}, #{content}, #{normalized}, #{keywords}, #{tokenCount}, #{indexVersion})
mapper.update: update ai_document set status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{documentId} and status in ('READY_FOR_REVIEW', 'PUBLISHED')
update ai_document set status = 'ARCHIVED', updated_at = now() where id = #{documentId}
mapper.insert: insert into ai_index_version (id, description, embedding_model, dimensions, chunk_size, chunk_overlap, status, published_at) values (#{id}, #{description}, #{embeddingModel}, #{dimensions}, #{chunkSize}, #{overlap}, 'PUBLISHED', now()) on conflict (id) do nothing
mapper.select: select count(*) from ai_document where status = 'PUBLISHED'
